## What is this about?

<!-- generated by aider + aider-skills + skill create-blog-entry-what-is-this-about -->
The Swiss Human Behavior Weather Radar is a web application that turns hourly weather forecasts for Swiss locations into a visual persona map. Every morning a GitHub Action calls the free Open‑Meteo API, generates a 24‑hour forecast JSON, and commits it to the repository. The React front‑end loads this static JSON, applies a rulebook that maps weather conditions to symbols, and renders them on a Leaflet map with a time slider. This lets developers and designers quickly see how weather influences different Swiss regions throughout the day. Anyone interested in weather‑driven visualizations can clone the repo, run `npm install`, and start the app to explore the radar.
